intro: Bob Evans is the Ohio-born family restaurant chain that grew out of a farm sausage business, serving breakfast all day alongside homestyle lunches and dinners like pot roast, country-fried steak and turkey and dressing. It runs about 440 restaurants, mostly in the Midwest and East. Below is the Bob Evans menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Bob Evans, a Rise & Shine breakfast is about $10.79, The Original Farmer's Choice about $11.79 and The Whole Hog about $14.99. Dinner plates such as Fork-Tender Pot Roast ($15.19) and the Country-Fried Steak platter ($14.39) come with two sides. Family meals that feed up to six run about $34 to $56. Breakfast is served all day, and prices vary by location.
hot_deal: Bob Evans value: the smaller Dinner Bell Plates and budget breakfasts like the Mini Sampler (about $5.99) and Sausage Gravy & Biscuits (about $6.99) are the cheapest ways to eat. Family meals that feed up to six work out to about $6 to $9 a person.

faqs.q: How much is breakfast at Bob Evans?
faqs.a: A Rise & Shine breakfast is about $10.79 and The Original Farmer's Choice about $11.79. Budget plates like the Mini Sampler start around $5.99. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Bob Evans serve breakfast all day?
faqs.a: Yes. Bob Evans serves its breakfast menu all day.

faqs.q: How much is the pot roast at Bob Evans?
faqs.a: The Fork-Tender Pot Roast dinner is about $15.19 with two sides, and the pot roast family meal is about $55.99.

faqs.q: How much are Bob Evans family meals?
faqs.a: Family meals that feed up to six run about $34 to $56, depending on the entrée.

faqs.q: What is Bob Evans known for?
faqs.a: Its farm-style breakfasts, sausage gravy and biscuits and homestyle dinners like pot roast.
